questions.question: Briefly explain major components of an ICT system. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Briefly explain the major components of an ICT system.
  • • Hardware: Physical components like CPU, keyboard, monitor, printer.
  • • Software: System software (OS) and application software.
  • • Data: Raw facts processed to generate information.
  • • People: Users such as operators, administrators, programmers.
  • • Procedures: Rules, policies, and instructions for using ICT systems.
  • • Networks/Connectivity: Communication channels connecting devices and sharing data.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain components of MS Word. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the components of MS Word.
  • • Title Bar: Displays document name and application name.
  • • Ribbon: Contains tabs like Home, Insert, Layout, etc., each with tools.
  • • Quick Access Toolbar: Provides shortcuts for commands like save, undo.
  • • Workspace / Document Area: Main area where text is typed.
  • • Status Bar: Shows page number, word count, language, and zoom controls.
  • • Scroll Bars: Allow vertical and horizontal movement through the document.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Mention the role of Formulas Tab in Excel. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Mention the role of the Formulas Tab in Excel.
  • • Provides tools for entering formulas and functions.
  • • Function Library: Groups like Math, Text, Logical, Date & Time, Lookup.
  • • Defined Names: Create and manage named ranges.
  • • Formula Auditing: Trace precedents, dependents, show formulas.
  • • Calculation group: Set calculation options—automatic or manual.
  • • Helps users perform complex calculations efficiently.

questions.question: Define Information Technology (IT) and Information and Communication Technology (ICT). Explain the differences between them. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Define Information Technology (IT) and Information and Communication Technology
  • (ICT). Explain the differences between them.
  • Definition of IT (Information Technology):
  • • IT refers to the use of computers, software, storage, and networks for creating,
  • processing, storing, retrieving, and securing information.
  • • Focuses mainly on information processing using technological tools.
  • Definition of ICT (Information and Communication Technology):
  • • ICT is an extension of IT that includes communication technologies.
  • • It covers tools that enable communication, sharing, and transmission of information
  • (email, internet, mobile technology, networks).
